senses.gloss: m. (cmp. סְמָדָר, a. σεμίδαλις) finest flour (in Targ. Y. corresp. to סֹלַת in Targ. O.).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 29:2">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:6">Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 6</cite> <he>ס׳ דסולתא</he> (h. text <he>קמח סלת</he>).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 74b">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>בס׳ דמיפרך</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בסְמִידִי דמפריר</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>בדסִימְדִי</he>) in the case of a paste of the finest flour, which is brittle.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:15">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>לחמא דס׳ לכלבי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ס׳</he> only) bread of finest flour was given to the dogs and was not wanted (i.e. there was great affluence).
<cite ref="Pesachim 42a">Pes. 42ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>פת נקייה דס׳</he> ‘pure bread’ means bread of fine flour.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 989:54">Yalk. Koh. 989</cite> <he>אייתי צמידא וכ׳</he> bring me bread of fine flour and good wine &c.; a. fr.—Denom. <he>סְמִידִי</he>, <cite ref="O00688"><he>סִימְדִּי</he></cite>, v. supra.
